title: Selection sort: pick the minimum each round

steps.caption: Selection sort: find the smallest remaining value and swap it into the next position.
Scan indices 0..4: the smallest is 10 at index 1.
Swap it into index 0. Positions 0..0 are final.
Scan indices 1..4: the smallest is 13 at index 4.
Swap it into index 1. Positions 0..1 are final.
Scan indices 2..4: the smallest is 14 at index 2.
Swap it into index 2. Positions 0..2 are final.
Scan indices 3..4: the smallest is 29 at index 4.
Swap it into index 3. Positions 0..3 are final.
Always n²/2 comparisons, even on sorted input, but at most n − 1 swaps.
